The device is placed on a brown wooden surface. The iconic white click wheel and central button are clearly visible against the black faceplate. The screen is dark/off. A portion of a cardboard box is visible in the upper left background.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The translucency and refraction of the blue silicone case appear slightly uniform and lack complex internal light scattering, giving it a mildly synthetic or 'waxy' look common in AI generations, though physically plausible.

The tiny text/icons on the click wheel (Menu, Play/Pause, etc.) are extremely faint and lack sharp definition, appearing more as vague smudges than crisp laser-etched markings, which is a minor fidelity issue.

To verify the physical separation between the iPod/case stack and the wooden table surface, ensuring no floating or grounding errors.
